status: implemented and locally verified; user aesthetic review pending
goal: Small recognizable puffy pixel-art cloud shadows with natural spacing, restrained density and feathered edges; preserve lighting integration and saves; open local build for review.
changes: Four connected puff profiles with a shallow oval base
20 irregularly spaced, separated clouds with varied scale, handedness and density
One smooth density envelope per cloud avoids bubble-like internal patches
Startup feather radius reduced from 6 to 3 native pixels
Drift slowed from (3.2, 0.7) to (2.4, 0.55) native pixels per second

validation.scope: Cloud rendering and controls, sunlight/hero/dust sampling, native pixels, weather, day/night and full gameplay/RNG snapshots. No core or unrelated effects changed.

visual_review.iteration: First rounded-base draft looked like bubbles; unified density and shallow base corrected before final verification.
visual_review.motion: 288 captured frames spanning 24 seconds at 12 fps; inspected samples at 0, 8, 16 and 23.9 seconds. In-game motion remains at application frame rate.
visual_review.art: Code-native pixel shadow mask; no generated raster art or external assets.

simplicity: Only production file changed is SunShafts.cs: startup mask construction and drift constants. Existing rendering, alpha blur, world sampling and saved controls reused; no remaining findings. Test runner adds a focused option and captures three additional outdoor contexts.

launch.window_title: Yipe! III | Enter / A: actions | Esc / Start: pause
launch.purpose: Latest local build with the existing full adventure; no save replacement. Screenshot confirms restored adventure paused in Maynard.
launch.refresh_workaround: The normal app stalled in Cocoa_GL_SwapWindow. This temporary launcher instantiates the identical Desktop game assembly with SynchronizeWithVerticalRetrace=false before Run; no saved preference or production code changed.
